questions.question: Write a program that reads a text file and analyzes the frequency of each alphabet letter (a-z).
questions.solution_html:
• (a-z).
  • Answer
  • # Open and read the file
  • filename = ‘example.txt'
  • with open(filename, 'r') as file
  • text = file.read().lower() # Convert all text to lowercase
  • # Initialize dictionary for letters
  • count = {}
  • for ch in text
  • if ch.isalpha(): # Count only letters
  • if ch in count
  • count[ch] += 1
  • else
  • count[ch] = 1
  • # Print letter counts
  • for letter in sorted
  • print(letter, ":", count[letter])

questions.question: Develop a Python program to create a dictionary from two lists: keys = values =. Display the dictionary and update the `"age"` to 22.
questions.solution_html:
• Develop a Python program to create a dictionary from two lists and update 'age' to 22.
  • Answer
  • keys =
  • values =
  • # Create empty dictionary
  • my_dict = {}
  • # Add key-value pairs using a loop
  • for i in range(len(keys))
  • my_dict[keys[i]] = values[i]
  • print("Original Dictionary:", my_dict)
  • # Update 'age' to 22
  • my_dict['age'] = 22
  • print("Updated Dictionary:", my_dict)
  • Output
  • Original Dictionary: {'id': 101, 'name': 'Anu', 'age': 21}
  • Updated Dictionary: {'id': 101, 'name': 'Anu', 'age': 22}
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025
